# EFSA business-rule data

`BR_Data.csv` lists, per food group, the processes that turn a raw commodity
into a derivative that already exists in FoodEx2, with EFSA's ordinal codes.
EFSA's business rules BR16 and BR19 use it.

- Source: [openefsa/catalogue-browser](https://github.com/openefsa/catalogue-browser),
  `business-rules/BR_Data.csv`, last changed 2020-05-20.
